title: Get Out of the Way
setup: Your pawn on b7 wants b8, but your own rook is sitting on it, and Black's rook is loose on d2.
hint: Your own rook is the blockade here. It has to leave, and it must leave with something Black cannot ignore.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rh8+}} clears b8 with check. {{Kxh8}} is the best Black has — {{Kg6}} leaves the rook standing too — and {{b8=Q+}} promotes with check again and White is a queen for a rook ahead. A piece standing on its own queening square must vacate with tempo.
